claims.claim: Clean and Sharp UK Used Canon EOS D650 DSLR Camera
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a black Canon DSLR and reads Canon branding; model is stated as EOS 650D. No evidence of 'UK used' origin or overall cleanliness beyond visible body/lens.
Witness report shows lens barrel with focal length markings where 18–55 is visible.
Witness report notes the camera works/condition details are not shown; LCD is not clearly readable and no functional tests are reported.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show close-up lens glass inspection; fungus/scratches are not confirmed in the provided observations.
No shutter count readout is shown in the witness photos.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Included accessories are listed as not shown; no proof of battery/charger originality or repair history is visible.

risks.risk: Unconfirmed shutter count and overall shutter/sensor wear; could be much higher than claimed.
risks.proof: A camera menu screenshot showing shutter count (or a shutter count report from a connected app) plus a live view test video.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used DSLR with unknown shutter count and potential wear (worst-case: higher shutter count / normal wear).

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (fungus, haze, scratches) not verifiable from the witness shots.
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photos of the lens front element and rear element at an angle (including against light) and a focus test clip showing sharpness across the frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition unknown (worst-case: possible haze/fungus/scratches affecting image quality).

risks.risk: Camera functionality not proven (autofocus accuracy, shutter actuation, sensor health, LCD functionality).
risks.proof: Short test clips: autofocus on a moving subject, a burst shot, and a photo taken at multiple apertures with a quick review showing sharp results; also a clear LCD screen-on photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'not fully tested' / possible faults (worst-case: AF or sensor issues).

risks.risk: Missing/uncertain accessories and completeness (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card, box).
risks.proof: A laid-out accessories photo showing each item (battery model label, charger label, lens caps, strap, memory card) and ports/battery door latch close-ups.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown bundle (worst-case: missing one or more key accessories).

risks.risk: Exact lens variant not confirmed (e.g., whether it’s IS version), which affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens front and side markings showing whether it includes IS (image stabilization) and the full lens model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic 18–55 kit lens without assuming IS.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the lens glass (front and rear) against light to check for fungus/haze/scratches.
Provide a shutter count screenshot/readout from the camera or a connected tool/app.
Show a short autofocus + sharpness test clip (moving subject) and a burst shot review.
Send a clear photo of the LCD screen turned on (showing menus) to confirm it’s functional.
Lay out all included accessories and photograph each item (battery label, charger label, lens caps, strap, memory card if included).
Provide a clear photo of the lens markings to confirm the exact lens model (including whether it’s IS).
Show close-ups of ports and battery door latch to confirm they’re intact.
response.reason: The witness report reliably identifies the item as a Canon EOS 650D DSLR with an 18–55 lens, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. Seller claims about shutter count, lens cleanliness, and full working order are not verifiable from the provided observations, so pricing should assume unknown/possibly imperfect condition until proof is provided.
